profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Open Dental Software
profile.summary:
I’m a results-driven engineer who thrives at the intersection of technology, teamwork, and innovation. My career in full stack development and technical leadership has given me hands-on experience with a broad range of technologies — including AngularJS/Angular (JavaScript/TypeScript), ASP.NET (C#), MySQL, Google Web Toolkit (Java), Django (Python), AWS, and Docker — which I’ve used to build solutions that are both reliable and scalable.

I excel at translating complex problems into elegant, maintainable systems. Whether modernizing legacy platforms, architecting new applications from the ground up, or streamlining development pipelines, I combine technical expertise with a collaborative, people-first approach.

As a Web Development Team Lead, I’m committed to fostering an environment where engineers can do their best work — providing mentorship, removing blockers, and aligning our efforts toward impactful goals. My mission is to deliver technology that benefits the business while empowering the people who build it.

positions.title: Web Development Team Lead (Senior Software Engineer)
positions.description:
· Overhauled the API architecture using ASP.NET Web APIs backed by MySQL/MariaDB, significantly reducing request/response sizes, improving security, and enhancing scalability and reliability.
· Built and standardized a new Angular frontend using Material, RxJS, and Jest for testing. Led a team-wide push to improve code quality and test coverage, which significantly reduced bugs, enhanced accessibility, and shortened turnaround times for new features.
· Directed the implementation and modernization of several web applications, including: a secure messaging system using AWS S3 and SES; an online payment portal supporting multiple merchant services; a portal for customer-managed product key distribution; and a complete UI/UX overhaul of an online scheduling system.
· Oversaw the implementation of an API logging feature to provide deeper insight into usage patterns, user activity, and previously undetected errors.
· Researched and set up CI/CD pipelines in GitLab to run unit tests automatically upon each commit, preventing several bugs from being released to production.
· Designed code generators and environment tools to automate boilerplate tasks and streamline project setup, saving engineering hours and reducing the cognitive load required to contribute to applications.
· Wrote and maintained internal documentation to clearly define setup/troubleshooting processes, communicate team responsibilities and maintenance requirements to management and IT, and speed up the onboarding process for new web engineers.
· Managed a team of four engineers through weekly 1:1s focused on technical growth, career development, and delivery support.
· Sent weekly progress reports to management summarizing team tasks and project statuses, enabling leadership to maintain a high-level view of ongoing work and adjust priorities more effectively.
· Designed a new project management interface to improve visibility into both outstanding and historical project work.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Designed and implemented a configurable web application for online patient scheduling, allowing customization of appointment reasons and clinic-level availability.
· Maintained and added features to several legacy web applications using Google Web Toolkit (Java 8), including: an internal server/service status monitor, a patient portal for online billing/payments and secure communication, and an online forms system with customer-managed templates.
· Built and maintained several ASPX-based request forms used by customers to request services such as online medication management, custom report development, and data conversions from competing platforms.
· Contributed numerous features and bug fixes to the core C# .NET Framework codebase, including shareable prompt-driven notes, session management for cloud-based customers, and customizable view layout.
· Served as a domain expert for major portions of the web codebases, frequently consulted on technical direction and viability of potential features.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Improved and maintained an AngularJS/Django web application for building, testing, and publishing documentation, ensuring consistent output and reliability.
· Contributed to a new Vue.js application intended to replace the legacy system, adding OAuth authentication via Auth0 and enabling large-file uploads to AWS S3.
· Designed and implemented a web feature that allowed users to run QA scripts against their documentation packages and receive detailed reports.
· Implemented a feature that allowed users to view their publication history and statuses.
positions.insights: Skills: AngularJS · Web Development · Django · Vue.js · Python

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
· Improved and maintained a datacenter issue tracker (AngularJS/Node.js/MySQL) including creating a feature that consolidated many related issues into a single view, resulting in more efficient workflows for datacenter engineers.
· Built a Python/Tkinter desktop tool to alert engineers to simulations or tasks requiring attention, reducing response time to free up server resources.
· Automated recurring workflows — such as report emailing and data collation — with Bash and Perl scripts, reducing manual effort for the team.
· Developed SQL queries and integrated results into Excel Power Pivot dashboards, providing the IT department with real-time graphical reporting.

positions.title: Web Development Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
· Moderated course forums by answering student questions, fostering engagement, and sharing supplemental resources.
· Held weekly office hours to provide live coding assistance and concept clarification.
· Evaluated and provided constructive feedback on student assignments and projects, supporting their learning and development.

positions.title: Web Technology Coordinator
positions.description:
· Worked with software engineers to write regression tests and report bugs/request enhancements for eServices features.
· Implemented new processes to improve workflow and communication for eServices team members.
· Trained and assisted technicians with software installation and troubleshooting calls.

positions.title: Phone Support Technician
positions.description:
· Provided prompt and friendly software support to dental practices, including installation and customer training.
· Performed internal IT duties including workstation setup and network printer setup.

positions.title: Merchandiser
positions.description:
- Coordinate point of sale system installation and training 
- Promote business visibility at Chamber of Commerce and Home Builder Association meetings
- Manage advertisement contracts, design advertisements
- Create store displays and provide friendly and professional customer service

positions.title: Lab Technician, New Media Communications Game Lab
positions.description:
- Analyze and report on virtual environment visual aesthetics and story progression 
- Research subjects such as nonlinear storytelling and the evolution of storytelling in video games
- Teach other student employees to write quality video game reviews 
- Set up, maintain, and solve issues with lab equipment

positions.title: Submission Review Board Member & Radio Host
positions.description:
- Reviewed art submissions for quarterly publication
- Co-Hosted weekly radio show discussing art and literature
- Assisted with office organization and magazine distribution

honors.issuer: Issued by Open Dental Software · Feb 2016

honors.title: Most Dedicated Student of the Year
honors.description: Awarded for my persistence in seeking out extra duties and going above and beyond the responsibilities of the position.
